name: custom-filament-profile-creator
description: Companion app that creates Snapmaker_Orca filament profiles tailored to each vendor's SDS/TDS PDF
_note: No build step needed — the frontend uses window.__TAURI__ globals (withGlobalTauri: true). To develop locally, install tauri-cli via `cargo install tauri-cli` then run `cargo tauri dev` from this directory.
